## LARPD Diaper Drive Success
### LARPD Collects Nearly 8,000 Diapers
The Livermore Area Recreation and Park District (LARPD) collected nearly 8,000 diapers during its 2026 Diaper Drive, thanks to community members who came together to support local children and families through Hively, a Tri-Valley nonprofit organization.
The annual drive included collection sites at the Robert Livermore Community Center, LARPD Youth Services Offices, and LARPD Extended Student Services (ESS) sites at local Livermore schools. Community members were invited to donate diapers to help local families experiencing the financial burden of purchasing diapers.
“This diaper drive is a great example of families supporting families,” said Rachel Shelnut, Recreation Field Supervisor. “Our community came together to provide diapers, and Hively will help make sure those donations reach families who need them.”
Hively provides programs and services that strengthen children and families and improve access to resources throughout the Tri-Valley. The donated diapers will support Hively’s efforts to provide essential supplies to families in the community.
LARPD thanks everyone who participated in the 2026 Diaper Drive and helped make the collection a success.
For more information, visit LARPD.org or behively.org

## Master Plan Update
### LARPD Parks, Recreation, and Trails Master Plan Update
Planning the future of Livermore’s parks, trails, facilities, and recreation programs.
### Master Plan Update: Public Review Draft - September 2026:
LARPD has completed the Public Review Draft of the Parks, Recreation, and Trails Master Plan. LARPD presented the draft to the Board of Directors on August 26, 2026, and has finalized it for a 30-day public review period beginning in September.
The Master Plan will guide LARPD’s investment in parks, trails, facilities, and recreation services over the next 10 years.
View Public Review Draft:
Public Review Draft - September 2026.pdfInitial Study Mitigated Negative Declaration Sept 2026.pdf
### Current Phase: Public Review
### About the Parks, Recreation and Trails Master Plan
LARPD is updating its Parks, Recreation, and Trails Master Plan—a strategic blueprint that will guide the maintenance, improvement, and development of parks, trails, facilities, and recreation programs over the next 10 years.
This Master Plan is a community-centered vision for Livermore’s future recreational spaces, helping LARPD define its role in providing parks, recreation, trails, and open space while preparing for the community's evolving needs.
This document aims to:
- Establish a clear vision and goals for LARPD’s parks, programs, and facilities.
- Develop a regional approach to recreation and park management.
- Respond to changes in housing and community density, planning spaces where people live, gather, and play.
- Provide a foundation for future funding strategies, grant applications, and capital investment.
- Ensure parks, trails, and programs remain accessible, inclusive, and enjoyable for everyone.
### Community Outreach and Engagement
Community input helped shape the Master Plan through a community survey, workshops, pop-up outreach events, stakeholder discussions, and public Board meetings.
- Community Survey Key Findings
- Phase 3 Community Engagement Summary

## Scholarship
### Community Support Scholarship Program
The LARPD Foundation funds the Community Support Scholarship Program to provide Livermore residents access to LARPD's recreation programs.
Eligible Programs:
- Recreation Classes
- Camps
- Swim Lessons
- Drop-In Programs
- Sports Programs
- Sports Leagues
- Open Space Classes
Individuals are eligible for up to $400 each year. ($1200 per family)
#### How to Apply
English Application
Proof of Income: Do not mail information; please bring the following with you to the interview.
1. Copies of the most recent one month’s worth of consecutive pay stubs for any parent who lives in the household. (For Example, If you get paid weekly, there should be four pay stubs: bi-weekly, two pay stubs, etc.)
2. Proof of residency (Utility bill/lease agreement)
3. Current tax return (not W-2)
4. Verification of any other source of income (child support, disability, public assistance, unemployment, etc.)
Spanish Application
#### Prueba de ingresos: No enviar la siguiente información por correo, favor de traerla el día de su entrevista
- Copias de los talones de cheques mas recientes (consecutivos) del ultimo mes, por cada padre viviendo en casa. (Por ejemplo: si usted recibe pago por semana, deberán de ser 4 talones de cheque; si usted recibe pago cada dos semanas, deberán de ser 2 talones de cheque.)
- Prueba de Residencia (Recibo de utilidades/Contrato de renta)
- Declaración de Impuestos actuales (No formas W2)
- Verificación de cualquier otra fuente de ingreso. (sustento de niños, deshabilitad, asistencia publica, desempleo, etc.)
Please Note: You must be a Livermore resident to apply for the Community Support Scholarship.
For questions about this program, please contact Eligibility Specialist Elizabeth Martinez at emartinez@larpd.org
